status: implemented; 11 new native test groups and all 28 spatial regression groups passed; 36 UI tests and TypeScript check passed
algorithm_origin: Original analytical implementations; no recovered Evoto code, trained models, or parity claims
working_resolution: Maximum 256 pixels on the long edge. Correction interpolation retains full-resolution original detail.
selection_contract: All new methods derive neighbours, interpolation taps, airlight, covariance and other statistics only from positive selection coverage. Outside pixels are unchanged. Coverage blends corrections once.
limits: These tools are deterministic analytical operators, not semantic face/body models.
Dark-channel haze inversion is a selected-region heuristic.
Connected spot repair operates on components of at most four working-grid cells.
Adaptive median window expands only through 7x7 cells; apertures use at most 49 samples.
Notch radius stores cycles per working-grid cell, exposed explicitly in the UI.

methods.label: Adaptive impulse median
methods.mechanism: Expand the selected median neighborhood up to seven cells to identify isolated bright or dark impulses.

methods.label: Sigma-gated colour smoothing
methods.mechanism: Average only selected neighbours within an explicit RGB distance from the current pixel.

methods.label: Distance-weighted colour median
methods.mechanism: Estimate each channel with a weighted median that favors nearby selected samples.

methods.label: Luminance percentile limiter
methods.mechanism: Clamp luminance to the selected neighborhood tenth and ninetieth percentiles while retaining channel ratios.

methods.label: Chroma range smoothing
methods.mechanism: Average colour differences with chroma-distance and spatial weights while preserving luminance.

methods.label: Chroma covariance denoising
methods.mechanism: Measure two-dimensional chroma covariance and shrink its noisy principal components while preserving luminance.

methods.label: Colour covariance denoising
methods.mechanism: Diagonalize measured local RGB covariance and suppress components below the chosen noise floor.

methods.label: Entropy-weighted detail
methods.mechanism: Measure an eight-bin local luminance entropy and use it to weight residual detail gain.

methods.label: Local RMS contrast
methods.mechanism: Rescale luminance residuals toward a chosen local RMS contrast, with bounded gain.

methods.label: Log-illumination correction
methods.mechanism: Estimate geometric mean illumination and move it toward an authored reference while retaining reflectance.

methods.label: Oriented periodic notch
methods.mechanism: Fit a local sine and cosine at an authored frequency and orientation, then subtract their bounded luminance contribution.

methods.label: Cross-footprint median
methods.mechanism: Take a selected-only colour median along a cross rather than a square footprint.

methods.label: Curvature ridge detail
methods.mechanism: Measure Hessian principal curvature and adjust ridge contrast with a bounded luminance correction.

methods.label: Coherent structure detail
methods.mechanism: Measure structure-tensor coherence to concentrate detail gain along consistent edges.

methods.label: Least-dispersion line median
methods.mechanism: Choose the colour median of the least dispersed horizontal, vertical, or diagonal selected line.

methods.label: Curved-surface residual detail
methods.mechanism: Fit a local six-term quadratic surface and adjust residual detail above smooth curved illumination.

methods.label: Windowed-sinc selection shift
methods.mechanism: Resample an explicit shift with a six-tap Lanczos kernel and clamp ringing to the selected footprint range.

methods.label: Elliptical aperture integration
methods.mechanism: Integrate a rotated elliptical Gaussian aperture within the selection.

methods.label: Hexagonal aperture integration
methods.mechanism: Integrate a uniform six-sided aperture with selection-aware samples.

methods.label: Cat-eye aperture integration
methods.mechanism: Integrate intersecting discs; aperture clipping increases away from the authored optical centre.

methods.label: One-sided highlight streak
methods.mechanism: Spread only brighter-than-current highlight energy along a rotated exponential trail.

methods.label: Range-aware base compression
methods.mechanism: Compress a luminance-range-filtered local base while retaining its fine residual.

methods.label: Selected dark-channel haze repair
methods.mechanism: Estimate selected airlight and local dark-channel transmission for bounded haze inversion. This is a heuristic, not scene-depth inference.

methods.label: Connected spot repair
methods.mechanism: Repair colour-connected components of at most four working cells from their selected boundary median.

methods.label: Luminance-preserving chroma median
methods.mechanism: Apply channel-difference medians while retaining luminance and reducing out-of-gamut chroma.
